poc_plan: 2-week perf+regression POC on Hosted: (1) baseline with hosted default model streaming, (2) A/B route 50/50 to quantized variant, (3) collect token latency distribution, quality evals on 1k prompt-set, (4) run canary with progressive traffic ramp if quality delta < threshold.
latency_targets: 1st-byte streaming target 200-350ms; tail 95th < 800ms; interactive chat turnaround < 1.5s for typical 40-token responses.
model_preferences: open models preferred (smaller/faster variants), willing to test Redwood-verified quantized variants; fallback to larger model if quality drops.
eval_strategy: Automated eval gating per deployment: baseline prompt set + user-facing synthetic sessions; A/B + canary thresholds (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-similarity + custom heuristics for tool-calls). Alerts to AE/SE on regressions.
procurement_notes: Procurement loop expecting SOC2 artifacts and a 60-day SLA review; finance requested committed monthly spend scenarios for Dedicated (3 tiers).
